visualGoal: Kitaptaki market sırası ve mor su aygırı kasiyer sahnesini, sıra bekleme davranışını görsel olarak anlaşılır kılan oynanabilir bir mekâna dönüştürmek
artRules: queue position is communicated by floor/world illustration, never a CSS rectangle
cashier remains a separate character asset and is not baked into the background
counter perspective and cashier foot/body anchor must agree
shelves frame the scene without hiding Catpat or interaction points
static signage text, if used, must be authored into the image and Turkish copy checked before baking
